Hi everyone. I'm a beginner in this competition documenting my parameter experiments on the JIRKA baseline. So far:
● Default settings: 0.728
● USE_COUNT_CALIBRATION = True: 0.728 (no change)
● DETECT_DIV = True: 0.695 (worse, division detection hurts without tuning)

Currently testing BUDGET_SAFETY adjustments. Happy to share results. I would love to hear what parameter ranges others have found useful.
